method: CUA-only native UI interaction; read-only plist/process checks for persistence and lifecycle. No app code or normal app preferences were changed.

checks.name: normal-relaunch-suppresses-welcome-and-controls
checks.evidence: A new process launched normally after Command-Q. Its only exposed window was spriglet.pet; no prototype controls window or welcome/Get Started content was present.

checks.name: pet-remains-available-after-relaunch
checks.evidence: The spriglet.pet window exposed the accessible Spriglet button, and the CUA screenshot showed the rendered companion at 224 by 224 points.

checks.name: standard-application-menu-remains-available
checks.evidence: The Spriglet application menu opened and exposed About Spriglet and Quit Spriglet.

checks.name: leaf-menu-show-welcome-is-transient
checks.evidence: CUA exposed the standard application menu but not the MenuBarExtra leaf menu. A bounded standard keyboard-navigation attempt did not reveal it; Show Welcome was not invoked. This is an automation limitation, not an observed application failure.

checks.name: normal-preferences-preserved
checks.evidence: Normal sandbox preference-file hash and ordinary preference-domain absence match the pre-test baseline.

limitations: Show Welcome through the leaf menu needs a manual end-to-end check; source inspection alone was not treated as UI evidence.
CUA getAXState transparently relaunches a quit app. This was used intentionally for the normal relaunch check; the last quit used inventory inspection instead so the fixture remained stopped.
This checks the current local ad hoc Release copy, not a notarized download or a fresh Gatekeeper-enabled Mac.
